name: Bitcoin
day_summary: Bitcoin crashed −9.5% to ~$63,500 as a hot 172K US payrolls print sent yields and the dollar higher and broke the risk tape; BTC fell hardest as the highest-beta risk asset. A brutal day for longs; shorts and puts made the week.

decision.rationale: The macro framework that supported risk just broke. SELL/de-risk hard: reduce exposure, raise cash, and do not buy the first leg down of a rate shock — high-beta crypto leads to the downside.

positioning.short_interest: longs liquidated en masse as the print hit
positioning.notable_flow: Spot-ETF outflows and the NFP shock triggered the first big liquidation wave; vol exploded.

what_traders_are_doing: Wholesale de-risking on the rate shock; BTC was sold as the highest-beta expression of risk, leading the entire complex lower.

news.label: Hot 172K payrolls broke the equity framework (SPX −2.64%, VIX ~20.9, 30Y above 5.0%); crypto fell hardest

outlook.short_term: Sharp downtrend; expect follow-through and liquidations.
outlook.long_term: Thesis intact but irrelevant until the rate regime stabilizes.

bull_case: Violent moves can exhaust quickly once leverage clears.
bear_case: A rate shock with no Fed relief in sight; BTC trading as pure risk-beta.
ETF outflows accelerate the down move.
